parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the group to which the devices belong.

- If you specify this parameter, the device statistics of the specified group are returned. If you also specify **ProductKey**, the device statistics of the specified product in the specified group are returned.
- If you do not specify this parameter or **ProductKey**, the device statistics of all devices under the current account are returned.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the devices belong.
- If you specify this parameter, the device statistics of the specified product are returned. If you also specify **GroupId**, the device statistics of the specified product in the specified group are returned.
- If you do not specify this parameter or **GroupId**, the device statistics of all devices under the current account are returned.
